healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Acute care hospitals, freestanding emergency departments, ambulatory and urgent care centers, inpatient behavioral health facilities, and virtual behavioral care. Prominence Health offers insurance.

clinical_specialty.label: Clinical specialty
clinical_specialty.value: Emergency medicine and behavioral health, including mental health treatment.

payer_revenue_mix.label: Payer revenue mix
payer_revenue_mix.value: Commercial managed care, Medicare, and Medicaid are major sources of provider revenue, including managed Medicare and managed Medicaid.

payment_reimbursement_model.label: Payment / reimbursement model
payment_reimbursement_model.value: Medicare pays by case for acute inpatient care, by service group for hospital outpatient care, and per diem for inpatient psychiatric care.

setting_specific_capacity.label: Setting-specific capacity
setting_specific_capacity.value: Large network of acute care hospitals, freestanding emergency departments, ambulatory centers, and behavioral health facilities with inpatient beds.

patient_acuity_case_mix.label: Patient acuity / case mix
patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Acute hospital and emergency care, plus behavioral health treatment across inpatient, outpatient, and virtual settings.

clinical_operating_quality.label: Clinical operating quality
clinical_operating_quality.value: UHS reports high patient experience scores and received the Press Ganey Human Experience Guardian of Excellence Award.
